title: CIA psychiatrist explains why Hall was chosen: 41 men before him came back compromised

tellings.quote: He said the 41 men that went out before me who all came back compromised and some of them burned.

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret military site in Nevada, in the 1960s, tells podcast host Jesse Michels why he says he was picked for the job. He says an unnamed psychiatrist from the CIA, the US spy agency, told him that the 41 men sent out before him had all come back compromised, and some had been burned. He also tells his story in his book Millennial Hospitality.
